Admissions Inquiries

Undergraduate Students

You can find the answers to your questions about admissions, programs, and applying to UBC by visiting the Undergraduate Programs and Admissions website.

Contact the Admissions Office

Graduate Students

Please use the Graduate Degree Programs listing to find master and doctoral programs at UBC. It provides the most important information about admission requirements, deadlines, funding sources and tuition, research supervisors, statistical data and career outcomes. Each program profile has a contact form to reach out to individual programs with specific questions.
